It also frames the activity around supporting leaders and top-line members, indicating a recruitment-linked earning structure rather than neutral financial education or market commentary.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S05 fits because the video promotes holding or accumulating OneCoin tokens with a promised doubling of the viewer's existing balance and additional earnings. S06 is additionally supported by explicit references to leaders, top lines, members, and account qualification, which connect benefits to a multi-level structure.
